description: This is a C# source file defining the class 'ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain' implementing the 'IActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain' interface. It manages activation and deactivation call logs, providing methods to retrieve and clear recorded calls, utilizing Microsoft.Extensions.Logging for logging purposes.

classes.name: ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain
classes.description: Implements a grain that tracks activation and deactivation calls, allows retrieval and clearing of call logs.

methods.name: GetActivateCalls
methods.description: Returns a Task containing an array of activation call strings.

methods.name: GetDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Returns a Task containing an array of deactivation call strings.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the activation and deactivation call logs.

methods.name: RecordActivateCall
methods.description: Records an activation call with the provided activation string.

methods.name: RecordDeactivateCall
methods.description: Records a deactivation call with the provided activation string.
